evidence.summary: CASI describes the Information Engineering University in Zhengzhou as one of the PLA’s five comprehensive universities, formed in 1999 from PLA schools of information engineering, electronic technology (founded as a school for confidential communications staff) and surveying and mapping. It hosts the State Key Laboratory of Mathematical Engineering and Advanced Computing and a national engineering laboratory for computer virus defence, runs a cyber training range, and teaches cryptography, intelligence analysis, technical reconnaissance and information countermeasures.

CASI reports that the university was under the PLA General Staff Department from 1999 to 2016 and then under the Central Military Commission’s Training and Administration Department, and identifies it as a Strategic Support Force university.
